coverageGaps: TryCastSkill exceeds eight physical GP slots and is not hooked. No entry-context/XMM observation or getter callback is used.
Raw instance pointers and per-instance IDs are conditional same-lifetime observations, not globally unique cast identifiers. Init is not a cast.
Input callback observation does not prove OS key-held state. Scoped predicates are visible only under an admitted paired ancestor.
No server acknowledgement, exhaustive reject taxonomy, asynchronous causal join or numerical damage operand admission.
Nullable request snapshots require selected fresh cache-layout proof; Refresh return is not cast acceptance.

Skill.DoCast is not hooked: its Nullable options need an indirect ABI witness and the selected TryCastSkill path initializes casting inline rather than directly calling DoCast. Ability.BeforeCast and pending-dispatch are narrower observed boundaries.
